component.name: IDA Agent
component.summary: AI Chat and MCP integration for IDA Professional
IDA Professional 的 AI Chat 与 MCP 集成

description.p: Install the IDA Agent plugin for your user and open the local configuration manager for external AI clients. Requires a separately installed and licensed IDA Professional 9.4 with its bundled Qt 6.8.2.
为当前用户安装 IDA Agent 插件，并打开外部 AI 客户端的本地配置管理页。需要单独安装并许可的 IDA Professional 9.4 及其自带的 Qt 6.8.2。
